name: CLASS MAID
source:
Haruka - a classmate of mine, my beloved - is now in my house, serving me, as a maid. Cooking, laundry, sweeping.....and surprisingly, she is pleased to make me cum! Is this real?? What's going on here????

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE004832.html]English DLSite[/url]]
translation:
遥——我的同学，我心爱的人——现在在我家里，作为女仆为我服务。做饭、洗衣、扫地……令人惊讶的是，她很高兴让我高潮！这是真的吗？？这是怎么回事？？？

[来自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE004832.html]英文DLSite[/url]]
